name: Rediscovering the Light
summary: Offered by Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell, this task challenges newly raised Forsaken paladins to embrace the Holy Light once more. Calling upon holy powers inflicts intense agony upon undead flesh, requiring fledgling paladins to channel healing into injured Deathguards despite the burning torment.

sections.title: A Painful Reunion
sections.body: For former champions of the Silver Hand and fallen knights of Lordaeron, awakening in undeath means confronting a horrifying reality: the Holy Light still answers their call, but it burns their withered bodies from within. Aramis Hammerhand instructs newly risen Forsaken paladins that abilities once practiced as second nature now bring excruciating pain. Because holy energy naturally conflicts with the foul magic sustaining undeath, channeling the Light requires raw willpower and agonizing perseverance.

sections.title: Purification Through Suffering
sections.body: Rather than allowing this torment to deter them, Forsaken paladins view the pain as an enduring testament of faith. Deathguard throughout Deathknell suffer grievous wounds combating mindless zombies, and it falls upon these undead knights to restore them. Aramis teaches that pushing through the burning pain is like exercising an atrophied muscle—the agony itself is treated as a badge of honor and living proof that the Light has not forsaken them.

faq.q: Why does using the Light hurt Forsaken paladins?
faq.answer: The Holy Light is fundamentally opposed to the necrotic energies that sustain undeath. While a Forsaken's will and conviction allow them to channel the power of the Light, circulating that sacred energy through dead flesh inflicts excruciating, burning pain.
Aramis Hammerhand is an undead paladin trainer stationed in Deathknell. He guides newly risen Forsaken paladins as they reforge their shattered connection to the Holy Light.

faq.q: Why are the Deathguards in Deathknell injured?
faq.answer: The Deathguard are the soldiers defending Deathknell from mindless undead, feral Scourge remnants, and hostile wildlife that surround the settlement as the newly risen awaken from their graves.

faq.q: Can undead naturally wield the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Yes, provided they retain the faith, willpower, and memory of their former vows. The Light responds to genuine conviction, though it exacts a brutal physical toll upon dead bodies.

faq.q: What does Aramis mean when he calls pain a badge of honor?
faq.answer: Aramis views the burning agony not as a curse, but as undeniable proof that the Light still listens. Forsaken paladins endure the searing heat of their spells to demonstrate their unyielding loyalty and purpose.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: It takes place entirely within Deathknell, the secluded starter haven in northwestern Tirisfal Glades where newly raised Forsaken first emerge into their undead existence.

angles.text: For an undead paladin, reconnecting with the Light is a crucible of faith and endurance, proving that holy vows can survive death itself despite the blistering agony it brings.
This rite demonstrates the fierce resilience of the Forsaken, who turn even the searing torment of the Light into a disciplined weapon for their survival.
